13909-the-indiscretion-of-the-duchess-be.title: The Indiscretion Of The Duchess Being A Story Concerning Two
13909-the-indiscretion-of-the-duchess-be.creator: Unknown
13909-the-indiscretion-of-the-duchess-be.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The same reason that absolves me from the need of excuse deprives me of the claim to praise; and, looking back, I am content to find nothing of which I need seriously be ashamed, and glad to acknowledge that, although Fate chose to put me through some queer paces, she was not in the end malevolent, and that, now the whole thing is finished, I have no cause to complain of the ultimate outcome of it.

arxiv-2104-08032.title: Sampling in Λ \Lambda -shift-invariant subspaces of Hilbert-Schmidt operators on L 2 ​ ( ℝ d ) L^{2}(\mathbb{R}^{d})
arxiv-2104-08032.creator: Antonio G. García
arxiv-2104-08032.description: Abstract The translation of an operator is defined by using conjugation with time-frequency shifts. Thus, one can define Λ \Lambda -shift-invariant subspaces of Hilbert-Schmidt operators, finitely generated, with respect to a lattice Λ \Lambda in ℝ 2 ​ d \mathbb{R}^{2d} . These spaces can be seen as a generalization of classical shift-invariant subspaces of square integrable functions.

arxiv-2110-01836.title: Intermediately subcritical branching process in random environment: the initial stage of the evolution Thanks: This work is supported by the Russian Sciences Foundation under grant 19-11-00111
arxiv-2110-01836.creator: Dyakonova E.E.
arxiv-2110-01836.description: Abstract Аннотация We consider branching process evolving in i.i.d. random environment. It is assumed that the process is intermediately subcritical case. We investigate the initial stage of the evolution of the process given its survival up to the distant moment of time. AMS 2000 subject classifications. Primary 60J80; Secondary 60G50. Keywords.

arxiv-2112-13015.title: Dynamics of active run and tumble and passive particles in binary mixture
arxiv-2112-13015.creator: Vivek Semwal, Jay Prakash Singh, Shradha Mishra
arxiv-2112-13015.description: Abstract We study a binary mixture of disk-shaped active run and tumble particles ( A ​ R ​ N ​ P ​ s {ARNPs} ) and passive particles on a two-dimensional substrate. Both types of particles are athermal. The particles interact through the soft repulsive potential.

arxiv-2205-07260.title: Guidelines for the Regularization of Gammas in Batch Normalization for Deep Residual Networks
arxiv-2205-07260.creator: Bum Jun Kim, Hyeyeon Choi, Hyeonah Jang, Dong Gu Lee, Wonseok Jeong, Sang Woo Kim
arxiv-2205-07260.description: Abstract L 2 L_{2} regularization for weights in neural networks is widely used as a standard training trick. However, L 2 L_{2} regularization for γ \gamma , a trainable parameter of batch normalization, remains an undiscussed mystery and is applied in different ways depending on the library and practitioner.

arxiv-2207-04072.title: Five texture zeros in the lepton sector and neutrino oscillations at DUNE
arxiv-2207-04072.creator: Richard H. Benavides, D. V. Forero, Luis Muñoz, Jose M. Munoz, Alejandro Rico, A. Tapia
arxiv-2207-04072.description: Abstract In this work, we have assumed special structures for the charged and neutral mass matrices in the lepton sector, inspired by structures for the up and down quark mass matrices that result by assuming a certain number of symmetrical zeros in their entries named texture zeros .

arxiv-2308-07383.title: Density-functional description of materials for topological qubits and superconducting spintronics
arxiv-2308-07383.creator: Philipp Rüßmann, David Antognini Silva, Mohammad Hemmati, Ilias Klepetsanis, Björn Trauzettel, Phivos Mavropoulos, Stefan Blügel
arxiv-2308-07383.description: Abstract Interfacing superconductors with magnetic or topological materials offers a playground where novel phenomena like topological superconductivity, Majorana zero modes, or superconducting spintronics are emerging. In this work, we discuss recent developments in the Kohn-Sham Bogoliubov-de Gennes method, which allows to perform material-specific simulations of complex superconducting heterostructures on the basis of density functional theory.

arxiv-2311-05817.creator: R.Anantharaman
arxiv-2311-05817.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by R.Anantharaman. In this expository paper we discuss the volume product P(K) of convex bodies K in R n R^{n} ; this is the product of volumes of K and its polar K*. arxiv-2312-08996.creator: Aditi Dudeja
arxiv-2312-08996.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Aditi Dudeja. In this paper, we consider the problem of maintaining a ( 1 − ε ) (1-\varepsilon) -approximate maximum weight matching in a dynamic graph G G , while the adversary makes changes to the edges of the graph. In the fully dynamic setting, where both edge insertions and deletions are allowed, Gupta and Peng [ GP13 ] gave an algorithm for this problem with an update time of O ~ ε ​ ( m ) \tilde{O}_{\varepsilon}(\sqrt{m}) .

arxiv-2407-16420.title: Feasibility of Li decorated Si 6 C 14 and Si 8 C 12 nanocages as promising hydrogen storage media: A computational study
arxiv-2407-16420.creator: Ankita Jaiswal, Rakesh K. Sahoo, Sridhar Sahu
arxiv-2407-16420.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ankita Jaiswal, Rakesh K. Sahoo, Sridhar Sahu. This article presents the reversible hydrogen storage capacities of Li decorated Si 6 C 14 and Si 8 C 12 using Density Functional Theory (DFT). The chemical stabilities of the designed Si 6 C 14 Li 6 and Si 8 C 12 Li 4 nanocages are investigated using HOMO-LUMO gaps and various global reactivity descriptors such as chemical hardness and electrophilicity index.

arxiv-2408-03779.title: V407 Lup, an intermediate polar nova
arxiv-2408-03779.creator: M. Orio, M. Melicherčík, S. Ciroi, V. Canton, E. Aydi, D. A. H. Buckley, A. Dobrotka, G.J.M. Luna, J. Ness
arxiv-2408-03779.description: Abstract We present X-ray and optical observations of nova V407 Lup (Nova Lup 2016), previously well monitored in outburst, as it returned to quiescent accretion. The X-ray light curve in 2020 February revealed a clear flux modulation with a stable period of 564.64 ± \pm 0.

plos-pone-0351760.creator: Chih-Yu Chen, Kuang-Hui Chen, Kang-Hao Lu
plos-pone-0351760.description: Start order and medal outcomes: An analysis of apparatus finals in men’s artistic gymnastics

pmc-10520050.title: C. elegans germ granules sculpt both germline and somatic RNAome
pmc-10520050.creator: Ian F. Price, Jillian A. Wagner, Benjamin Pastore, Hannah L. Hertz, Wen Tang
pmc-10520050.description: Germ granules are membrane-less organelles essential for small RNA biogenesis and germline development. Among the conserved properties of germ granules is their association with the nuclear membrane. Recent studies demonstrated that LOTUS domain proteins, EGGD-1 and EGGD-2 (also known as MIP-1 and MIP-2 respectively), promote the formation of perinuclear germ granules in C. elegans.

pmc-10551003.title: Comparison of antithrombin activity assays in detection of patients with heparin binding site antithrombin deficiency: systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10551003.creator: Tamara Rojnik, Nataša Sedlar, Nana Turk, Andrej Kastrin, Maruša Debeljak, Mojca Božič Mijovski
pmc-10551003.description: Antithrombin (AT) deficiency increases the risk for venous thromboembolism, therefore, a highly sensitive assay to identify this condition is crucial. The aim of this paper was to perform a meta-analysis comparing AT activities measured by different AT activity assays in patients with heparin binding site AT deficiency.

pmc-10673253.title: Brachybacterium conglomeratum Is Associated with Cervicovaginal Infections and Human Papilloma Virus in Cervical Disease of Mexican Female Patients
pmc-10673253.creator: Iliana Alejandra Cortés-Ortíz, Jonathan Puente-Rivera, Guiedaana Ordaz-Pérez, Alejandra Yareth Bonilla-Cortés, Paula Figueroa-Arredondo, Carlos Alberto Serrano-Bello, Eduardo García-Moncada, Gustavo Acosta-Altamirano, Daniel Ernesto Artigas-Pérez, Juan Carlos Bravata-Alcántara, Mónica Sierra-Martíne
pmc-10673253.description: Brachybacterium conglomeratum, traditionally considered an environmental bacterium, has recently garnered attention for its potential involvement in human health. While prior research hinted at its pathogenic role in humans, our study aims to determine its prevalence and associations in diverse clinical contexts.

pmc-10719470.title: Patient and healthcare professional acceptability of pharmacogenetic screening for DPYD and UGT1A1: A cross sectional survey
pmc-10719470.creator: Sarah Glewis, Mei Krishnasamy, Senthil Lingaratnam, Sam Harris, Craig Underhill, Chloe Georgiou, Mark Warren, Robert Campbell, Maarten IJzerman, Mussab Fagery, Ian Campbell, Jennifer H. Martin, Jeanne Tie, Marliese Alexander, Michael Michael
pmc-10719470.description: This study explored the acceptability of a novel pharmacist‐led pharmacogenetics (PGx) screening program among patients with cancer and healthcare professionals (HCPs) taking part in a multicenter clinical trial of PGx testing (PACIFIC‐PGx ANZCTR:12621000251820). Medical oncologists, oncology pharmacists, and patients with cancer from across four sites (metropolitan/regional), took part in an observational, cross‐sectional survey. Participants were recruited from the multicenter trial.

pmc-11378089.title: Primary hepatic leiomyosarcoma with adrenal and hepatic metastasis: Case report and literature review
pmc-11378089.creator: Chaymae Faraj, Youssef Mahdi, Sara Essetti, Fatima Chait, Hatim Essaber, Asaad El Bakkari, Youssef Omor, Rachida Latib, Sanae Amalik, Basma El Khannoussi
pmc-11378089.description: Primary hepatic leiomyosarcoma (PHL) is a rare malignant tumor, which originates from smooth muscles. The imaging features are nonspecific and the diagnosis is often delayed until the tumor reaches a large size, which leads often to a dismal prognosis. We report a case of a 46-year-old male patient who was complaining about abdominal pain for 2 months.

pmc-11462450.title: Spermidine supplementation influence on protective enzymes of Apis mellifera (Hymenoptera: Apidae)
pmc-11462450.creator: Tatjana V Čelić, Srđana Đorđievski, Elvira L Vukašinović, Ivan Pihler, Danijela Kojić, Jelena Purać
pmc-11462450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Dietary supplementation has been proposed as a sustainable way to improve the health and resilience of honey bees (Apis mellifera, L.), as the decline in their numbers in recent decades has raised scientific, environmental, and economic concerns. Spermidine, a natural polyamine, has been shown to be a promising substance for honey bee supplementation, as its health-promoting effects have been demonstrated in numerous studies and in different organisms.

pmc-11506482.title: The Evolution of Illicit-Drug Detection: From Conventional Approaches to Cutting-Edge Immunosensors—A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11506482.creator: Nigar Anzar, Shariq Suleman, Yashda Singh, Supriya Kumari, Suhel Parvez, Roberto Pilloton, Jagriti Narang
pmc-11506482.description: The increasing use of illicit drugs has become a major global concern. Illicit drugs interact with the brain and the body altering an individual’s mood and behavior. As the substance-of-abuse (SOA) crisis continues to spread across the world, in order to reduce trafficking and unlawful activity, it is important to use point-of-care devices like biosensors.

pmc-11615177.title: Shared and distinct changes in the molecular cargo of extracellular vesicles in different neurodegenerative diseases
pmc-11615177.creator: Anna F. Wiersema, Alyssa Rennenberg, Grace Smith, Suzy Varderidou-Minasian, R. Jeroen Pasterkamp
pmc-11615177.description: Neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD), amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and Parkinson’s disease (PD) affect millions of people worldwide. Curative treatment for these neurodegenerative disorders is still lacking and therefore a further understanding of their cause and progression is urgently needed.

pmc-11682568.title: Midfoot Beam-Plate Constructs for Charcot Neuroarthropathy: A Cohort Study with Midterm Follow-Up
pmc-11682568.creator: Patrick C McGregor, Ryan G Rogero, William C Skinner, Clayton C Bettin
pmc-11682568.description: Category:Midfoot/Forefoot; DiabetesIntroduction/Purpose:Charcot neuroarthropathy (CN) is a complex disease process with degeneration of normal foot architecture. The goal of surgical treatment for CN is achieving and maintaining a plantigrade ulcer-free foot. Operative treatment options for CN vary widely including debridement, exostectomy, and complex reconstruction.

pmc-12384728.title: Juggling the Limits of Lucidity: Searching for Cognitive Constraints in Lucid Dream Motor Practice: 4 Case Reports
pmc-12384728.creator: Emma Peters, Clarita Bonamino, Kathrin Fischer, Daniel Erlacher, Luigi De Gennaro
pmc-12384728.description: Background/Objectives: Lucid dreaming (LD), during which the dreamer becomes aware of the dream state, offers a unique opportunity for a variety of applications, including motor practice, personal well-being, and nightmare therapy. However, these applications largely depend on the dreamer’s ability to control their dreams.

pmc-12521068.title: A Review on the Double Burden of Diabetes and Myocardial Infarction: Healthcare Challenges and Future Prospects in Low and Middle‐Income Countries
pmc-12521068.creator: Md. Shajid Hossain Rafi, Sanjida Chowdhury Ivy, Syed Masudur Rahman Dewan
pmc-12521068.description: Background and AimThe dual burden of diabetes and myocardial infarction (MI) significantly increases morbidity and mortality, especially in low‐ and middle‐income countries (LMICs). This study evaluates current treatment strategies, emphasizing the impact of limited access to medications, diagnostics, and specialized care. It proposes adaptable solutions tailored to resource‐constrained settings.

pmc-12690641.title: Computed tomography image analysis of cobalt oxide nanoparticles-induced cytopathic effect on Hep-G2 cell lines
pmc-12690641.creator: Mohamed S. Nasr Eldin, Moustafa A. Soula, Ahmed A. Emara, Hala M. Ahmed, Widad M. Al-Bishri, Gharieb S. El-Sayyad
pmc-12690641.description: The main aim of the present study is to examine the effect of cobalt oxide nanoparticles (Co3O4 NPs) on the proliferation of hepatocellular carcinoma (Hep-G2) cells. The cells were exposed to red light with a wavelength of λ = 655 nm for 30 minutes at a power of 50 mW cm−2 and in the dark.

pmc-12701064.title: Revealing the topological nature of entangled orbital angular momentum states of light
pmc-12701064.creator: Robert de Mello Koch, Pedro Ornelas, Neelan Gounden, Bo-Qiang Lu, Isaac Nape, Andrew Forbes
pmc-12701064.description: Topology has emerged as a fundamental property of many systems yet mostly limited to low dimensions. Here, we reveal the hidden topology in entangled states carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM), in arbitrary dimensions. For two-dimensional systems, we demonstrate multiple skyrmion topologies and their equivalence to ’t Hooft-Polyakov magnetic monopoles, experimentally connecting them to the Higgs field.

pmc-13040988.title: Clinical and molecular characterization of Krabbe disease in Iranian patients: case report and literature review
pmc-13040988.creator: Parnia Asgari, Iman Elahi Vahed, Sahand Tehrani Fateh, Farzad Hashemi-Gorji, Mohammad-Reza Ghasemi, Ali Mardi, Seyed Hassan Tonekaboni, Mohammad Miryounesi, Shadab Salehpour
pmc-13040988.description: Krabbe disease (KD, OMIM #245200) is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder characterized by severe demyelination affecting both the central and peripheral nervous systems. Here we report the clinical and molecular findings of two unrelated Iranian patients with KD, originating from consanguineous families. Genetic analysis was initially performed using whole-exome sequencing (WES), then validated by Sanger sequencing.

pmc-13072116.title: Does Aromaticity Drive Metal Cation Binding to Nanographenes? Insights Into Regioselectivity and Cation‐π Bonding
pmc-13072116.creator: Omkar Charapale, Sergio Posada‐Pérez, Albert Poater, Miquel Solà
pmc-13072116.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Nanographenes, a subclass of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs), have attracted significant interest due to their unique electronic properties and broad applications in materials science, optoelectronics, energy storage, and organic chemistry. Here we investigate the interactions of alkali and alkaline‐earth metal cations (Li+, Na+, K+, Be2+, Mg2+, Ca2+) with five D‐symmetric PAHs/nanographenes ranging from benzene to circumcircumcircumcoronene, aiming to elucidate the roles of aromaticity and topology in governing cation binding.

pmc-13096558.title: Multi-electron nitrobenzothiadiazole sp-conjugated-alkynyl covalent organic frameworks for ammonium-ion batteries
pmc-13096558.creator: Yumin Chen, Da Zhang, Yang Qin, Chengmin Hu, Ling Miao, Yaokang Lv, Ziyang Song, Lihua Gan, Mingxian Liu
pmc-13096558.description: Covalent organic frameworks containing periodic redox-active motifs and conjugation structures are booming as competitive negative electrodes for ammonium-ion batteries. Introducing substantial single-electron active motifs linked by dynamic imine bonds can increase their capacity; however, this design is constrained by suboptimal single-electron redox efficiency and insufficient linkage stability.

pmc-13581629.title: Progression of bilateral adrenal incidentalomas: a monocentric cohort study
pmc-13581629.creator: Alessandra Mangone, Ilaria Pes, Sofia Frigerio, Riccardo Renda, Emanuele Ferrante, Erika Peverelli, Giovanna Mantovani, Serena Palmieri
pmc-13581629.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeBilateral adrenal incidentalomas (BAIs) are increasingly detected during abdominal imaging. Their initial clinical, hormonal, and radiological presentation is heterogeneous, and their natural history remains unclear. Current ESE/ENS@T guidelines lack specific recommendations for BAIs management.MethodsRetrospective single-center cohort study enrolling 185 consecutive non-operated patients referred between 2009 and 2023 to our endocrinology unit for BAIs (≥10 mm) with thorough assessment of hormonal, genetic and radiological data. Exclusion criteria were interfering comorbidities or incomplete data.
